blocks.text: Umumiy ma'no: I like music, I hate exams

Biror narsa haqida **umuman** gapirganda — qandaydir aniq narsa emas, balki uning hammasi, butun turi haqida — inglizchada **artikl qo'yilmaydi**. Sanaladigan ot bunda **ko'plikda** keladi (dogs, exams, books), sanalmaydigan ot — o'z shaklida (music, money, life). I like **music** — musiqani (umuman) yaxshi ko'raman. **Dogs** are loyal — itlar (hammasi, tur sifatida) sodiq bo'ladi.

Bu yerda o'zbek o'quvchisini ikki narsa chalg'itadi. Birinchisi — o'zbekchada umumiy ma'no ko'pincha **birlikda** aytiladi: «Olmani yaxshi ko'raman», «It — sodiq hayvon». Inglizchada esa sanaladigan ot umumiy ma'noda ko'plikda: I like **apples** («I like apple» emas). Ikkinchisi — tushum kelishigi `-ni`. 69-darsda `-ni` ko'pincha **the** ga mos kelishini ko'rdik, lekin umumiy ma'noda bu ishlamaydi: «Tarixni yaxshi ko'raman» — I like **history** («the history» emas). like, love, hate, enjoy, be interested in, be afraid of dan keyin keladigan ot ko'pincha aynan umumiy ma'noda bo'ladi.

Sanaladigan otni umumiy ma'noda ishlatish uchun uni ko'plikka qo'ying va artiklni tashlab yuboring: **Cats** sleep a lot. **Doctors** earn good money. I'm afraid of **spiders**. Bunday gaplar lug'at yoki ensiklopediyadagi ta'rifga o'xshaydi — gap biror aniq mushuk yoki shifokor haqida emas, ularning hammasi haqida.

Sanalmaydigan ot umumiy ma'noda shunchaki artiklsiz keladi: **Life** is short. **Water** boils at 100 degrees. I don't drink **coffee**. Mavhum tushunchalar (life, love, time, nature, education, history), moddalar (water, sugar, rice) va **-ing** bilan yasalgan otlar (swimming, smoking, shopping) shu guruhga kiradi.

Agar gap hamma narsa haqida emas, balki **aniq** bir guruh yoki narsa haqida bo'lsa — **the** qaytadi (69-dars). Odatda buni ot keyidagi so'zlar ko'rsatadi: **the** music **at the party**, **the** children **next door**, **the** coffee **in this café**. Yoki ikkala suhbatdosh qaysi biri ekanini biladi: Where's **the** cheese? (muzlatgichdagi o'sha pishloq).

rows: **The music** at the wedding was too loud.
**The vegetables** in this soup are fresh.
**The life** of Alisher Navoi is very interesting.
**The coffee** in this café is excellent.

items.text: Where's **the cheese**? I want a sandwich.

blocks.text: O'quv fanlari, tillar va sport turlari ham umumiy ma'nodagi otlar — artiklsiz: I study **history**. She speaks **English**. We play **football** (70-dars). Til nomidan keyin **language** so'zi kelsa — **the**: **the** English language. **the English** (artikl bilan, «language» siz) esa ingliz xalqini bildiradi.

rows: history, maths, physics, chemistry, biology, economics
English, Uzbek, Russian, Chinese — lekin **the** Uzbek **language**

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I like the music» (umuman) → **I like music**; «The life is beautiful» → **Life is beautiful**; «I like cat» → **I like cats**; «The money is not important» → **Money isn't important**; «I'm good at the mathematics» → **I'm good at maths**; «The people are lazy today» (umuman odamlar haqida) → **People are lazy today**.

Tekshirish usuli: gapga o'zbekcha «umuman», «hamma» so'zini qo'yib ko'ring. «Men umuman musiqani yaxshi ko'raman» — ma'noli → artiklsiz (**music**). «Kechagi musiqa yoqdi» — aniq → **the music**. Ot keyidan «of», «in», «at», «next door» kelib, uni aniqlab tursa — deyarli doim **the**.
Bog'liq darslar: ko'plik shakllari — 66-dars; sanalmaydigan otlar — 67–68-darslar; **a / an** va **the** — 69-dars; **the** bilan turg'un iboralar — 70-dars; joy nomlari — 73-dars.

rows: **The music** at the party was loud.

examples.title: I like **music**, I hate **exams**
examples.description: Nimanidir umuman yoqtirish yoki yoqtirmaslik: like, love, hate, enjoy, be afraid of, be interested in + ko'plik yoki sanalmaydigan ot, artiklsiz.

sentences.text: I really like **music**, especially Uzbek folk songs.
sentences.translation: Men **musiqani**, ayniqsa o'zbek xalq qo'shiqlarini juda yaxshi ko'raman.

sentences.text: Most students hate **exams**.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik talabalar **imtihonni** yomon ko'radi.

sentences.text: Aziz loves **animals**, so he wants to be a vet.
sentences.translation: Aziz **hayvonlarni** juda yaxshi ko'radi, shuning uchun veterinar bo'lmoqchi.

sentences.text: I don't like **horror films** — they scare me.
sentences.translation: Men **qo'rqinchli filmlarni** yoqtirmayman — ular meni qo'rqitadi.

sentences.text: Do you like **spicy food**? — Not really.
sentences.translation: **Achchiq taomlarni** yoqtirasizmi? — Unchalik emas.

sentences.text: Madina is terribly afraid of **spiders**.
sentences.translation: Madina **o'rgimchaklardan** juda qo'rqadi.

sentences.text: My grandfather enjoys **poetry**, and he knows many poems by Navoi.
sentences.translation: Bobom **she'riyatni** yaxshi ko'radi, Navoiyning ko'p she'rlarini yoddan biladi.

sentences.text: Emma can't stand **loud noise**, so she never goes to clubs.
sentences.translation: Emma **baland shovqinga** chiday olmaydi, shuning uchun hech qachon klublarga bormaydi.

sentences.text: Bekzod is interested in **cars** and **computers**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **mashinalar** va **kompyuterlar** bilan qiziqadi.

sentences.text: Children usually love **sweets**, but my son prefers **fruit**.
sentences.translation: Bolalar odatda **shirinlikni** yaxshi ko'radi, o'g'lim esa **mevani** afzal ko'radi.

examples.title: General facts: **Dogs** are loyal
examples.description: Umumiy fakt — sanaladigan ot ko'plikda va artiklsiz: **Cats** sleep a lot. O'zbekchada esa ko'pincha birlik: «**It** — sodiq hayvon».

sentences.text: **Dogs** are very loyal animals.
sentences.translation: **It** — juda sodiq hayvon.

sentences.text: **Cats** sleep for about sixteen hours a day.
sentences.translation: **Mushuklar** kuniga taxminan o'n olti soat uxlaydi.

sentences.text: **Doctors** often work very long hours.
sentences.translation: **Shifokorlar** ko'pincha juda uzoq soatlab ishlaydi.

sentences.text: **Bananas** don't grow in Uzbekistan — it's too cold in winter.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda **banan** o'smaydi — qishda juda sovuq.

sentences.text: **Teenagers** often sleep late at the weekend.
sentences.translation: **O'smirlar** dam olish kunlari ko'pincha kech uyg'onadi.

sentences.text: Are **mobile phones** bad for young children?
sentences.translation: **Mobil telefonlar** yosh bolalarga zararlimi?

sentences.text: In Uzbekistan **guests** are always welcome.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda **mehmon** doim aziz.

sentences.text: **Bicycles** are cheaper than **cars**, and they're better for the environment.
sentences.translation: **Velosiped** **mashinadan** arzonroq va atrof-muhit uchun foydaliroq.

sentences.text: **Women** usually live longer than **men**.
sentences.translation: **Ayollar** odatda **erkaklardan** uzoqroq umr ko'radi.

sentences.text: **Buses** in London are red, but **taxis** are usually black.
sentences.translation: Londonda **avtobuslar** qizil, **taksilar** esa odatda qora.

examples.title: **Life**, **money**, **time**: uncountable in general
examples.description: Sanalmaydigan ot umumiy ma'noda artiklsiz: **Life** is short. **Money** isn't everything. **-ing** shakli ham: **Smoking** is bad for you.

sentences.text: **Life** is short, so enjoy every day.
sentences.translation: **Hayot** qisqa, shuning uchun har bir kundan zavqlaning.

sentences.text: **Money** isn't everything, but it helps.
sentences.translation: **Pul** hamma narsa emas, lekin yordam beradi.

sentences.text: **Water** boils at a hundred degrees.
sentences.translation: **Suv** yuz darajada qaynaydi.

sentences.text: Regular **exercise** is good for your heart.
sentences.translation: Muntazam **jismoniy mashq** yurak uchun foydali.

sentences.text: I think **education** is very important for girls and boys.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, **ta'lim** qizlar uchun ham, o'g'il bolalar uchun ham juda muhim.

sentences.text: Dilnoza doesn't drink **coffee** — she prefers **green tea**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **qahva** ichmaydi — u **ko'k choyni** afzal ko'radi.

sentences.text: For me **time** is more important than **money**.
sentences.translation: Men uchun **vaqt** **puldan** muhimroq.

sentences.text: **Smoking** isn't allowed anywhere in this building.
sentences.translation: Bu binoning hech bir joyida **chekish** mumkin emas.

sentences.text: **Love** and **respect** are the most important things in a family.
sentences.translation: Oilada eng muhim narsa — **muhabbat** va **hurmat**.

sentences.text: **Sugar** is bad for your teeth, but my grandmother puts three spoons in her tea.
sentences.translation: **Shakar** tishlarga zarar, lekin buvim choyiga uch qoshiq soladi.

examples.title: General or specific: **music** / **the music**
examples.description: Bir gapda ikkalasi: umumiy ma'no — artiklsiz (**music**, **children**), aniq narsa yoki guruh — **the** (**the music** at the party, **the children** next door).

sentences.text: I love **music**, but **the music** at the party was terrible.
sentences.translation: Men **musiqani** yaxshi ko'raman, lekin ziyofatdagi **musiqa** dahshatli edi.

sentences.text: **Children** need a lot of sleep, but **the children** next door go to bed very late.
sentences.translation: **Bolalarga** ko'p uyqu kerak, qo'shnimizning **bolalari** esa juda kech yotadi.

sentences.text: **Vegetables** are good for you, and **the vegetables** from Grandma's garden are the best.
sentences.translation: **Sabzavotlar** foydali, buvimning bog'idagi **sabzavotlar** esa eng zo'ri.

sentences.text: I don't usually drink **coffee**, but **the coffee** in this café is excellent.
sentences.translation: Odatda **qahva** ichmayman, lekin bu kafedagi **qahva** a'lo.

sentences.text: **Books** are expensive, but **the books** in this shop are cheap.
sentences.translation: **Kitoblar** qimmat, lekin bu do'kondagi **kitoblar** arzon.

sentences.text: **Flowers** make people happy. — Thank you for **the flowers**!
sentences.translation: **Gullar** odamlarni xursand qiladi. — **Gullar** uchun rahmat!

sentences.text: **People** in big cities are often in a hurry, but **the people** in our street always say hello.
sentences.translation: Katta shaharlarda **odamlar** ko'pincha shoshib yuradi, bizning ko'chamizdagi **odamlar** esa doim salomlashadi.

sentences.text: **Information** is everywhere on the internet, but **the information** on this site is wrong.
sentences.translation: Internetda **ma'lumot** har joyda bor, lekin bu saytdagi **ma'lumot** noto'g'ri.

sentences.text: My father drinks **tea** all day, but he never drinks **the tea** from the office machine.
sentences.translation: Otam kun bo'yi **choy** ichadi, lekin ofisdagi apparatning **choyini** hech qachon ichmaydi.

sentences.text: **Exams** make me nervous, but **the exam** yesterday was easy.
sentences.translation: **Imtihonlar** meni hayajonga soladi, lekin kechagi **imtihon** oson edi.

examples.title: Subjects, languages, sports: **history**, **English**
examples.description: O'quv fanlari, tillar va sport turlari — artiklsiz: **history**, **maths**, **English**, **Uzbek**, **football**, **karate**.

sentences.text: **History** is my favourite subject at school.
sentences.translation: **Tarix** — maktabdagi eng sevimli fanim.

sentences.text: Do you speak **English** or **Russian** at work?
sentences.translation: Ishda **inglizcha** gaplashasizmi yoki **ruscha**mi?

sentences.text: Madina is very good at **maths**.
sentences.translation: Madina **matematikadan** juda kuchli.

sentences.text: **Football** is the most popular sport in Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda eng ommabop sport — **futbol**.

sentences.text: James is learning **Uzbek**, and he can already say a few sentences.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **o'zbek tilini** o'rganyapti, allaqachon bir nechta gap ayta oladi.

sentences.text: After school Bekzod wants to study **economics** or **law**.
sentences.translation: Maktabdan keyin Bekzod **iqtisodiyot** yoki **huquqshunoslik** bo'yicha o'qimoqchi.

sentences.text: I've never been interested in **politics**.
sentences.translation: Men hech qachon **siyosat** bilan qiziqmaganman.

sentences.text: Our children do **karate** after school twice a week.
sentences.translation: Bolalarimiz maktabdan keyin haftasiga ikki marta **karate** bilan shug'ullanadi.

sentences.text: **Chemistry** was difficult for me, but **biology** was easy.
sentences.translation: **Kimyo** men uchun qiyin edi, **biologiya** esa oson.

sentences.text: Sarah teaches **English** to adults, and in her free time she learns **Chinese**.
sentences.translation: Sara kattalarga **ingliz tilidan** dars beradi, bo'sh vaqtida esa **xitoy tilini** o'rganadi.

examples.title: Do you like **cats**? — Questions and answers
examples.description: Savol va javob: umumiy didni so'rash — artiklsiz (Do you like **cats**?), aniq narsa haqida — **the** (Did you like **the film**?).

sentences.text: Do you like **cats**? — Yes, but I'm allergic to them.
sentences.translation: **Mushuklarni** yoqtirasizmi? — Ha, lekin ularga allergiyam bor.

sentences.text: Does Aziz like **football**? — He loves it!
sentences.translation: Aziz **futbolni** yoqtiradimi? — Juda yaxshi ko'radi!

sentences.text: What kind of **music** do you listen to? — Mostly pop.
sentences.translation: Qanday **musiqa** tinglaysiz? — Asosan pop.

sentences.text: Are you afraid of **snakes**? — Of course I am!
sentences.translation: **Ilonlardan** qo'rqasizmi? — Albatta qo'rqaman!

sentences.text: Do you eat **meat**? — No, I'm a vegetarian.
sentences.translation: **Go'sht** yeysizmi? — Yo'q, men vegetarianman.

sentences.text: Did you like **the film**? — Yes, **the music** was beautiful.
sentences.translation: **Film** yoqdimi? — Ha, **musiqasi** ajoyib edi.

sentences.text: Is **coffee** bad for you? — Not if you drink one or two cups a day.
sentences.translation: **Qahva** zararlimi? — Kuniga bir-ikki chashka ichsangiz, yo'q.

sentences.text: And **dogs**? — I like them, but not **the dog** next door — it barks all night!
sentences.translation: **Itlar**-chi? — Yoqtiraman, lekin qo'shnining **itini** emas — u tun bo'yi huradi!

sentences.text: Why do **people** love Samarkand so much? — Because of **the history** and **the architecture**.
sentences.translation: Nega **odamlar** Samarqandni bunchalik yaxshi ko'radi? — Uning **tarixi** va **me'morchiligi** uchun.

sentences.text: Which do you prefer, **summer** or **winter**? — **Summer**, because I love **swimming**.
sentences.translation: Qaysi biri yoqadi, **yoz**mi yoki **qish**mi? — **Yoz**, chunki **suzishni** yaxshi ko'raman.

examples.title: Food: **bread** in general, **the bread** on the table
examples.description: Taomlar haqida: umumiy gap — artiklsiz (**fruit** is cheap, **fast food** is unhealthy), dasturxondagi yoki aniq joydagi taom — **the** (**the bread**, **the melons** from Khorezm).

sentences.text: **Bread** is sacred in Uzbek culture.
sentences.translation: O'zbek madaniyatida **non** muqaddas.

sentences.text: Is **the bread** fresh? — Yes, I bought it this morning.
sentences.translation: **Non** yangimi? — Ha, bugun ertalab oldim.

sentences.text: **Fruit** is cheap in summer, especially at the bazaar.
sentences.translation: Yozda, ayniqsa bozorda, **meva** arzon.

sentences.text: **The melons** from Khorezm are famous all over Central Asia.
sentences.translation: Xorazmning **qovunlari** butun O'rta Osiyoda mashhur.

sentences.text: I never put **salt** on my food.
sentences.translation: Men taomga hech qachon **tuz** sepmayman.

sentences.text: Could you pass **the salt**? **The soup** needs a little more.
sentences.translation: **Tuzni** uzatib yubora olasizmi? **Sho'rvaga** yana ozgina kerak.

sentences.text: **Fast food** is unhealthy, but teenagers love it.
sentences.translation: **Fast-fud** zararli, lekin o'smirlar uni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: **The pizza** at that Italian restaurant is better than in Italy!
sentences.translation: O'sha italyan restoranidagi **pitsa** Italiyadagidan ham mazali!

sentences.text: Emma doesn't eat **eggs**, so we made **the cake** without them.
sentences.translation: Emma **tuxum** yemaydi, shuning uchun **tortni** tuxumsiz pishirdik.

sentences.text: **Green tea** helps after a heavy meal, so after **the plov** Grandpa always makes a big pot.
sentences.translation: Og'ir ovqatdan keyin **ko'k choy** yordam beradi, shuning uchun **oshdan** keyin bobom doim katta choynakda choy damlaydi.

examples.title: Dialogue: what do you like?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: umumiy did — artiklsiz (**sport**, **football**, **music**, **food**), aniq narsa — **the** (**the plov** at your party, **the tea** after every meal).

sentences.text: — So, Tom, do you like **sport**?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, Tom, **sportni** yoqtirasanmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, I love **football**, but I hate **running**.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **futbolni** juda yaxshi ko'raman, lekin **yugurishni** yomon ko'raman.

sentences.text: — Me too! And what about **music**?
sentences.translation: — Men ham! **Musiqa**-chi?

sentences.text: — I listen to **jazz** mostly. Do you know any Uzbek singers?
sentences.translation: — Asosan **jazz** tinglayman. O'zbek xonandalaridan birortasini bilasanmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, lots! **Uzbek music** is very melodic — I'll send you some songs.
sentences.translation: — Ha, ko'p! **O'zbek musiqasi** juda ohangdor — senga bir nechta qo'shiq yuboraman.

sentences.text: — Thanks! By the way, **the plov** at your party was amazing.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat! Aytgancha, ziyofatingdagi **osh** ajoyib edi.

sentences.text: — My mum made it. She says good **plov** needs time and patience.
sentences.translation: — Uni oyim pishirgan. Uning aytishicha, yaxshi **osh** vaqt va sabr talab qiladi.

sentences.text: — I agree. **Food** in Uzbekistan is fantastic, but I can't eat so much **bread**!
sentences.translation: — Qo'shilaman. O'zbekistonda **taomlar** ajoyib, lekin men shuncha **non** yeya olmayman!

sentences.text: — Ha! Here **bread** is on the table at every meal.
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! Bu yerda har bir ovqatda dasturxonda **non** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — I know. And **the tea** after every meal — I love that tradition!
sentences.translation: — Bilaman. Har ovqatdan keyingi **choy** ham — bu an'anani juda yaxshi ko'raman!
